description: This file defines a StorageScript class responsible for serializing and restoring browser storage data, including localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB, with special handling for Firefox. It includes methods for collecting storage data, serializing it, and restoring it, as well as managing IndexedDB databases and cleaning service workers.

classes.name: StorageScript
classes.description: A class for serializing and restoring browser storage including localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB, with special handling for Firefox.

methods.name: _idbRequestToPromise
methods.description: Converts an IDBRequest to a Promise that resolves or rejects based on the request outcome.

methods.name: _isPlainObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain object, with special handling for Firefox.

methods.name: _trySerialize
methods.description: Attempts to serialize a value, returning either a trivial value or an encoded form.

methods.name: _collectDB
methods.description: Collects data from an IndexedDB database, serializing its stores and records.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects localStorage, and optionally IndexedDB, data into a serializable format.

methods.name: _restoreDB
methods.description: Restores an IndexedDB database from serialized data.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores storage state including localStorage, IndexedDB, and cleans service workers.
